ind.name: Poverty headcount (national line)
ind.src: HIES 2024-25, Planning Commission estimates (Economic Survey 2025-26, Table 16.1)

ind.name: Solar panels imported

ind.name: Internal freshwater per person

ind.name: SBP policy rate

ind.name: Money supply (broad money, M2)

sp_1998.src: ACAG/WashU satellite PM2.5 (V6.GL.02, CNN-calibrated, all components including dust and sea salt), district mean of 1 km cells, via Google Earth Engine community catalog.

sp_2005.label: Fine particles (PM2.5), 2005
sp_2005.src: ACAG/WashU satellite PM2.5 (V6.GL.02, CNN-calibrated, all components including dust and sea salt), district mean of 1 km cells, via Google Earth Engine community catalog.

sp_2010.label: Fine particles (PM2.5), 2010
sp_2010.src: ACAG/WashU satellite PM2.5 (V6.GL.02, CNN-calibrated, all components including dust and sea salt), district mean of 1 km cells, via Google Earth Engine community catalog.

sp_2015.label: Fine particles (PM2.5), 2015
sp_2015.src: ACAG/WashU satellite PM2.5 (V6.GL.02, CNN-calibrated, all components including dust and sea salt), district mean of 1 km cells, via Google Earth Engine community catalog.

sat_pm.label: Fine particles (PM2.5), 2022, all districts
sat_pm.src: ACAG/WashU satellite PM2.5 (V6.GL.02, CNN-calibrated, all components including dust and sea salt), district mean of 1 km cells, via Google Earth Engine community catalog.

sat_pmchg.label: Change in PM2.5, 1998-2022
sat_pmchg.src: ACAG/WashU satellite PM2.5 (V6.GL.02, CNN-calibrated, all components including dust and sea salt), district mean of 1 km cells, via Google Earth Engine community catalog.

sat_fire.label: Autumn crop fires (Oct-Nov), per 1,000 km²
sat_fire.src: NASA FIRMS active fires (MODIS, 1 km), detections in October-November averaged over 2020-2024, per 1,000 km² of district area. Mostly rice-stubble burning.

sat_firew.label: Spring crop fires (Apr-May), per 1,000 km²
sat_firew.src: NASA FIRMS active fires (MODIS, 1 km), detections in April-May averaged over 2020-2024, per 1,000 km². Mostly wheat-residue burning.

sat_rain.label: Average annual rainfall, 2000-2025
sat_rain.src: CHIRPS 2.0 satellite-gauge rainfall (UCSB), district mean annual total, 2000-2025.

sat_water.label: Land usually under water (rivers, lakes, wetlands)
sat_water.src: JRC Global Surface Water 1.4: average water occurrence 1984-2021 across the district (100% = always water).

mc_hw.label: Handwashing place with soap and water
mc_hw.src: A handwashing place was observed with water and soap or detergent. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_ecoli.label: Drinking water contaminated with E. coli
mc_ecoli.src: E. coli detected in a 100 ml sample of the household's drinking water (MICS water quality test). Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_cmar.label: Women 20-24 married before 18
mc_cmar.src: Women aged 20-24 who first married or entered a union before age 18. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_happy.label: Women who say they are very or somewhat happy
mc_happy.src: Women 15-49 who describe themselves as very or somewhat happy. Not asked in Balochistan. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_breg.label: Births registered, children under 5
mc_breg.src: Child has a birth certificate or the birth is registered with civil authorities. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20, Gilgit-Baltistan 2016. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_anx.label: Children 5-17 who seem very anxious every day
mc_anx.src: Mother or caretaker reports the child seems very anxious, nervous or worried daily (MICS child functioning module). Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_dep.label: Children 5-17 who seem very sad or depressed every day
mc_dep.src: Mother or caretaker reports the child seems very sad or depressed daily (MICS child functioning module). Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_fdif.label: Children 5-17 with a functional difficulty
mc_fdif.src: Difficulty in at least one domain: seeing, hearing, walking, self-care, communication, learning, remembering, concentrating, accepting change, behaviour, making friends, anxiety or depression (Washington Group/UNICEF child functioning). Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_disc.label: Children 5-14 who faced violent discipline last month
mc_disc.src: Any physical punishment or psychological aggression by a household member in the past month. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_read.label: Foundational reading skills, children 7-14
mc_read.src: Children who read 90% of words in a simple story correctly and answer all three literal and both inferential questions (MICS foundational learning module). Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

mc_num.label: Foundational numeracy skills, children 7-14
mc_num.src: Children who complete all four tasks: reading numbers, comparing numbers, addition and completing a pattern. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

fe_tfr.label: Total fertility rate (MICS)
fe_tfr.src: Births per woman at the age-specific rates of the three years before the survey, women 15-49. District rates rest on about 1,000-3,000 women each, so differences of 0.3 or less are within sampling error. Withheld for six districts (Kashmore, Dera Bugti, Gwadar, Kharan, Musakhel, Nushki) where recent births are inconsistent with completed family size or birth dates were mostly imputed. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

fe_tfr0.label: Fertility rate, women with no schooling
fe_tfr0.src: Total fertility rate for women 15-49 who never attended school (or pre-primary only). Shown where at least 300 such women were interviewed. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

fe_tfr2.label: Fertility rate, women with matric or more
fe_tfr2.src: Total fertility rate for women 15-49 whose highest level is secondary (matric) or higher. Shown where at least 300 such women were interviewed, so mostly Punjab. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

fe_wnone.label: Women 15-49 who never went to school
fe_wnone.src: Women 15-49 with no schooling or pre-primary only. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

fe_wsec.label: Women 15-49 with matric or more
fe_wsec.src: Women 15-49 whose highest level attended is secondary (matric) or higher. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

lfw_l.label: Women 15-49 in the labour force
lfw_l.src: Women 15-49 working or looking for work. Labour Force Survey 2020-21 (Pakistan Bureau of Statistics), computed from microdata with survey weights for women aged 15-49. In the labour force: worked at least one hour in the reference week, had a job or enterprise, or was looking for or available for work.

lfw_nf.label: Women 15-49 in non-farm work
lfw_nf.src: Women 15-49 employed outside agriculture, forestry and fishing. Labour Force Survey 2020-21 (Pakistan Bureau of Statistics), computed from microdata with survey weights for women aged 15-49. In the labour force: worked at least one hour in the reference week, had a job or enterprise, or was looking for or available for work.

lfw_sec.label: Women with matric or more in the labour force
lfw_sec.src: Women 15-49 with matric or more who are working or looking for work; shown where at least 100 such women were interviewed. Labour Force Survey 2020-21 (Pakistan Bureau of Statistics), computed from microdata with survey weights for women aged 15-49. In the labour force: worked at least one hour in the reference week, had a job or enterprise, or was looking for or available for work.

fe_res.label: Fertility above or below what women's schooling predicts
fe_res.src: District total fertility rate minus the rate expected from the share of women 15-49 with matric or more, using a straight-line fit across 129 districts (expected = 4.34 -0.021 × % with matric). Positive: more births than schooling alone predicts. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20.

ms_nomore.label: Married women who want no more children
ms_nomore.src: Says she wants no more children, or she or her husband is sterilised. Currently married women 15-49. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

ms_cp.label: Contraceptive use, married women (MICS)
ms_cp.src: Currently using any method to avoid pregnancy, modern or traditional. Currently married women 15-49. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.

ms_lastboy.label: Sons among last births, women who want no more
ms_lastboy.src: Share of boys among the most recent births of married women who want no more children or are sterilised. Without son preference this is about 51%; higher values mean couples stop once they have sons. Shown where at least 200 such women were interviewed; each district value carries about ±3-7 points of sampling error. Currently married women 15-49. Multiple Indicator Cluster Surveys: Punjab 2017-18, Sindh 2018-19, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa 2019, Balochistan 2019-20. Computed from MICS microdata (women's and birth-history files) with survey weights; districts split since the survey take their parent district's value.
